name: Konza National Data Centre
developer: Konza Technopolis Development Authority / Government of Kenya / Huawei
notes: Konza's official site describes the Konza National Data Centre as a Tier III Design and Construction facility serving government and enterprise cloud/colocation use. Public location descriptions place Konza Technopolis in the Machakos/Makueni/Kajiado buffer zone; county attribution should be verified for parcel-level siting.

name: Konza National Data Centre
developer: Konza Technopolis Development Authority / Government of Kenya / Huawei
notes: Included for Makueni coverage because Konza Technopolis is publicly described as spanning the Machakos/Makueni/Kajiado buffer zone and Konza materials reference benefits to Makueni, Kitui and Machakos. The data-centre project itself is confirmed, but precise county parcel attribution is not clear from accessible sources.

name: iColo Mombasa One (MBA1)
notes: Official iColo location page says MBA1 at Miritini has been operational since 2017 and the campus may expand to three data centres with 13 MW total IT load. iColo homepage lists Mombasa One IT power as 0.9 MW.

name: iColo Mombasa Two (MBA2)
notes: iColo announced MBA2 in Nyali on 2021-05-25 with estimated 1.6 MW capacity; DCD later reported completion and 1.7 MW capacity, around 1,200 sqm and roughly 580 racks.

name: iXAfrica Nairobi Campus NBOX1
notes: iXAfrica states its Nairobi NBOX1 campus has 22.5 MW overall design capacity and describes it as East Africa's first/largest hyperscale, carrier-neutral, AI-ready data centre. Safaricom partnership release confirms the same design capacity.

name: Africa Data Centres Nairobi / East Africa Data Centre (NBO1)
notes: Africa Data Centres' Nairobi facility page reports available site capacity of 7.5 MW and four Uptime Institute Tier III-certified data halls. DCD notes the existing EADC/Nairobi facility and ADC's expansion plans.

name: Africa Data Centres Nairobi second facility
notes: ADC announced it had begun development of a second Nairobi data centre of up to 20 MW IT load and was securing land for a third facility; later public status was not confirmed in accessible sources.

name: Africa Data Centres Sameer facility expansion
notes: Cassava/Africa Data Centres announced expansion of the Sameer facility in Nairobi by up to 15 MW of IT load using modular design; accessible source fetch timed out during collection but search index exposes the official announcement.

name: iColo Nairobi One (NBO1)
notes: Official iColo page says NBO1 launched in September 2019 in Karen with 280 racks and 624 sqm customer space. DCD's 2019 construction report stated the facility would support up to 825 kW IT load.

name: Digital Realty / iColo Nairobi Two (NBO2)
notes: Digital Realty lists NBO2 at Langata S Rd/LRC Rd with 3,600 sqm total building size. iColo social updates describe NBO2 as under construction and report 6.5 MW IT load; social source used for capacity/status.

name: PAIX Nairobi-1
notes: DCD reported PAIX Nairobi-1 at Britam Tower in Upper Hill, scheduled to open in November 2020, with 240 cabinets, 690 sqm whitespace and 1.5 MVA total power. Africa50 later describes PAIX as having operating assets in Ghana and Kenya.

name: Safaricom Limuru / Redhill data centre
notes: DCD reported Safaricom completed phase one at its Limuru/Redhill campus and planned 2.8 MW IT capacity by the end of phase two in January 2026. Limuru is just outside Nairobi; included under Nairobi City hub coverage because source describes it as outside the capital and not in a batch-listed county.

name: Safaricom Thika Data Centre
notes: Safaricom wholesale page states its data centres are located in Thika, Nairobi and Kisumu; Uptime Institute lists New Thika Data Centre for Safaricom with location Nairobi, Kenya. Capacity not found in public source.
